title: The Data Differentiator Framework (DDF): Quantifying Marginal Data Value with Information-Theoretic and Game-Theoretic Measures in an Agentic Evaluation Pipeline (SDSAE)
abstract: arXiv:2610.28933v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In data-rich enterprises the hard question is not whether a candidate dataset is good in isolation, but whether it adds information beyond what the organization already holds, and whether that increment is worth its price. We present the Data Differentiator Framework (DDF), a composite scoring method for candidate data assets that combines (i) a mutual-information-based redundancy penalty against the existing portfolio, (ii) a cost-normalized, significance-gated marginal utility score derived from an ablation study, and (iii) explicit governance inputs (trust, identity resolution quality, strategic weights) set by the business. The framework is executed by a staged pipeline, the Strategic Data Sourcing Agent Ecosystem (SDSAE), that short-circuits expensive model-retraining steps for assets failing governance or redundancy gates. translated_title: 数据差异化框架（DDF）：在智能体评估流水线（SDSAE）中利用信息论与博弈论度量量化数据的边际价值
translated_abstract: 在数据丰富的企业中，关键问题不是某个候选数据集在孤立状态下是否优秀，而是它能否在组织已有数据之外提供额外信息，以及这种增量是否物有所值。我们提出了数据差异化框架（DDF），这是一种针对候选数据资产的复合评分方法，它结合了：（i）基于互信息的、针对现有数据组合的冗余惩罚；（ii）通过消融研究得出的、经成本归一化并受显著性门控的边际效用评分；以及（iii）由业务方设定的明确治理输入（可信度、身份解析质量、战略权重）。该框架由一个分阶段的流水线——战略数据采购智能体生态系统（SDSAE）——执行，对于未通过治理或冗余门控的资产，该流水线会跳过昂贵的模型重训练步骤。从概念上讲，DDF 将 mRMR 特征选择中的“相关性减去冗余性”原则从特征层面……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出数据差异化框架（DDF），通过互信息冗余惩罚、成本归一化的边际效用评分和治理输入，量化候选数据资产相对企业已有数据的增量价值，并由智能体流水线SDSAE自动高效执行评估。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Data Differentiator Framework (DDF), which quantifies the marginal value of candidate data assets beyond an enterprise's existing data using mutual-information-based redundancy penalties, cost-normalized marginal utility scores, and governance inputs, executed efficiently by an agentic pipeline (SDSAE).
